items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: we said like a Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, he'd get off of the beautiful way he lived, and then he'd just pick arguments with anyone in the band.

ctx.x: Yeah. But what did he do when the moon changed? Can you tell me?

Well, we could, that's what we said, the musicians in the band, we'll joke how it would. Well, he's, his attitude would change, well, we said like a Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, he'd get off of the beautiful way he lived, and then he'd just pick arguments with anyone in the band. And that's how we knew that we had to stay clear of him a little, anyhow.
Would that be when the moon was full?
